2609.21492.title: LogicTrack: Auditing Reasoning Trajectories of Large Language Models with Formal Logic Solvers
2609.21492.paper_summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has been shown to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs), yet existing optimization methods largely rely on outcome-based feedback, leaving the logical validity of intermediate reasoning steps largely unverified. To address the gap whereby LLMs arrive at correct final answers through logically flawed intermediate reasoning chains, we propose LogicTrack, a neuro-symbolic framework that audits reasoning trajectories by auto-formalizing each reasoning step into symbolic representations and verifying it with automated theorem provers. LogicTrack introduces Solver-Based Backtracking Reward (SBR), a step-wise scoring mechanism that quantifies logical soundness and guides backtracking tree search at inference time. We further extend LogicTrack to construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data with backtracking traces from its trajectories, enabling fine-tuned models to internalize step-wise auditing as an intrinsic capability. Extensive experiments across 8 reasoning benchmarks and 7 LLMs demonstrate that LogicTrack effectively improves both the verifiability of reasoning chains and final answer pass rate, thereby enhancing overall CoT quality and trustworthiness in high-stakes domains.
2609.21492.paper_summary_zh: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 推理已被證明能提高大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的性能，然而現有的優化方法在很大程度上依賴於基於結果的反饋，導致中間推理步驟的邏輯有效性大多未經驗證。為了解決 LLMs 通過邏輯上有缺陷的中間推理鏈得出正確最終答案的問題，我們提出了 LogicTrack，一個神經符號框架，通過自動形式化每個推理步驟為符號表示並用自動定理證明器進行驗證，來審計推理軌跡。LogicTrack 引入了解決基於回溯的獎勵 (SBR)，這是一種逐步計分機制，用於量化邏輯的合理性並指導推理時的回溯樹搜索。我們進一步擴展 LogicTrack，以構建帶有回溯痕跡的監督式微調 (SFT) 數據，使微調模型能夠內化逐步審計作為一種內在能力。在 8 個推理基準和 7 個 LLMs 上進行的廣泛實驗表明，LogicTrack 有效提高了推理鏈的可驗證性和最終答案的通過率，從而增強了高風險領域中整體 CoT 的質量和可信度。
